z6ymqs2p.sourceDescription: This 180cm Christmas tree boasts a lush balsam fir design with 631 branch tips, accented by PE and PVC foliage, soft cashmere pine needles, 35 natural pine cones, and 35 vibrant red berry clusters for a festive touch. Pre-strung with 280 bright LED lights, it offers 9 dynamic lighting modes (change slow, C1 flash, C2 flash, change flash, change twinkle, etc), and 2 color options, warm white and multi-color. Designed for quick setup, hinged branches automatically fall into place, while a sturdy folding metal stand ensures stability and an instantly full appearance. Included gloves make decorating easier. Crafted from premium flame-retardant, non-allergic, smell-free, and fade-resistant materials, this artificial fir maintains its fresh beauty year after year. With a generous 275 cm power cord, you can position this seasonal centerpiece anywhere in your home to create a warm, inviting holiday ambiance. Merry Christmas! Note: Ornaments are not included. Full Balsam-Fir Look: Create a rich centerpiece with a full balsam fir tree featuring 631 branch tips. PE leaves with ice crystal accents and greenery PVC leaves offer a frosted, elegant vibe. Soft cashmere pine needles blend for depth, while 35 natural pine cones and 35 red berry clusters add natural holiday charm. Breathtaking Light Show: Set the mood fast with 280 pre-lit LED lights. Choose from 9 lighting modes plus 2 lighting colors, warm white and colorful, to match every holiday moment. The Christmas tree's CE-certified adapter makes it easy to switch styles and keep the celebration glowing safely. Quick Assembly, Less Hassle: Turn your space festive in minutes using hinged connections designed for smooth setup. The folding metal stand helps the pre-lit Christmas tree stay stable, so it looks full and balanced right from the start. A pair of gloves is included for comfortable handling, making decorating feel more enjoyable. High-Quality Materials: Enjoy worry-free decorating with 100% new PE and PVC materials that are flame-retardant, non-allergic, anti-fading, and smell-free. This helps the hinged Christmas tree keep its beautiful look season after season, so you can focus on cozy memories and a clean, fresh holiday atmosphere. Versatile Decoration: The 6 ft artificial Christmas tree comes with a 9 ft/275 cm long power cord that offers flexible placement, whether you want it near the living room centerpiece, by the staircase, or in a cozy corner for photos. The result is a more natural, welcoming holiday display wherever guests gather. Note: Ornaments are not included. Flocked Lime Green Branches: The 150 cm Xmas tree features 216 full branch tips crafted from 100% new PVC, which is fireproof, anti-fading, non-allergic, and smell-free. You can easily shape the treetop bent or straight, creating a custom look that perfectly fits your Christmas decorations and festive spirit. Warm White LED Lights: Designed with 80/120 pre-lit warm white LED lights, the artificial Xmas tree offers a gentle glow to enhance the magical Christmas atmosphere in any room. The included UL certified adaptor gives you worry-free, safe illumination all season long. 8 Festive Lighting Modes: Using the convenient light controller, you can select from a variety of delightful effects to suit any celebration mood - from combination, in wave, sequential, slo glo, chasing/flash, slow fade, twinkle/flash to steady on - making it easy to create a unique holiday display everyone will remember. A pair of gloves is included to protect your hands during setup, making it comfortable to prepare your tree for the perfect Christmas scene quickly. Versatile Multi-Scene Design: The Christmas tree looks stunning in entryways, offices, party venues, and any other festive space needing a joyful holiday touch. Its elegant shape and vibrant branches fit seamlessly with any style, helping you spread the warmth, wonder, and joy of the holiday season everywhere you celebrate. gh0ag74s.baseName: Walplus Wood Christmas Tree Stand 1.73 - Green - 50 x 50 x 16 cm
gh0ag74s.variantName: Walplus Wood Christmas Tree Stand 1.73 - Green - 50 x 50 x 16 cm
gh0ag74s.sourceDescription: This Christmas tree stand offers a contemporary design that seamlessly blends into any modern holiday setting. Its sleek and minimalist aesthetic allows for effortless integration into living rooms, making it a tasteful complement to your seasonal decor. Crafted with an eye for both beauty and durability, this stand offers a secure foundation for live or artificial Christmas trees, making it an ideal choice for those who appreciate simplicity without sacrificing functionality. Solid Pine Construction Carefully crafted from solid pine wood, this stand boasts strength and stability required for supporting Christmas trees of various sizes. Pine wood's natural durability ensures this product withstands the weight of your festive display, providing reliable use season after season. Modern Design Adopting a modern style characterized by clean lines and functionality, this Christmas Tree Stand merges effortlessly with contemporary interiors. It brings a refined edge to your festive display, enhancing the room's overall aesthetic without overwhelming it. Abrasion Resistance The stand features an abrasion-resistant surface that protects against scratches and scuffs, supporting its flawless appearance through multiple Christmas seasons. This feature ensures minimal maintenance, preserving the integrity of your festive centerpiece. Indoor and Outdoor Use Designed for versatility, the stand adapts to both indoor and outdoor setups. Whether displaying a tree in your living room or decking out your patio, it serves its purpose effectively, providing a secure and stable base in varied environments. Easy Care Instructions Maintaining the stand's pristine look is simple; just use a dry cloth to wipe away dust and avoid harsh chemicals. These straightforward care steps help maintain the wood's natural luster, ensuring a vibrant and polished appearance year after year. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: Solid pine wood Overall dimensions: 50 x 50 x 16 cm (L x W x H) Trunk diameter capacity: 13 Water reservoir capacity: 1.73 Style: Modern Durable Indoor / outdoor: Indoor & outdoor use Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree stand Assembly required: Yes This tree stand is designed solely for domestic holiday decoration and residential christmas tree support. To prevent severe crush injuries, property damage, or tip-over accidents, always verify that the total weight and height of your live or artificial tree do not exceed the maximum capacities specified by the manufacturer. Place the stand on a flat, solid, and completely level floor surface well away from busy doorways, hallways, or heat sources like radiators and fireplaces. Tighten all steel thumb bolts evenly into the trunk to guarantee perfect structural stability. Regularly check and top up the water reservoir for live trees to prevent drying, which creates a dangerous, rapid fire hazard. This seasonal holiday hardware is not a toy; keep all sharp metal clamping screws, heavy cast-iron bases, water spikes, and plastic retail packaging completely out of reach of children. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingdom.
